metricSemantics.instrumentation: DB query events are charged only to the deepest currently active measured stage.
metricSemantics.phaseWrapperQueryCount: Queries executed while no child measurement is active; this is an exclusive phase-wrapper count, not total phase queries.
metricSemantics.stageQueryCount: Queries exclusive to that named nested stage; it excludes its own nested children.
metricSemantics.comparisonRule: Do not compare phase-wrapper counts against stage counts or add a wrapper subtotal to a child subtotal as if both were inclusive. A full phase total is the sum of disjoint exclusive counters across the complete nesting tree.
metricSemantics.priorCountersMeaning: Existing baseline/final numeric counters were retained; their units/scope are clarified here, not converted into a different total.

transactionPolicy.locks: scope advisory lock retained; business lock acquired in existing order; resolver/cache lifetime is one interactive transaction only
transactionPolicy.integrity: full source snapshot, tenant/PDV, run/checkpoint, maps, batches, receipts and destination content validation retained at resume, every batch and finalization; no cross-transaction/run cache

classificationDefinitions.A_EXACT_SESSION_REFERENCE: One persisted session FK resolves to a source session belonging to the same tenant and the command event or PDV.
classificationDefinitions.B_HISTORICAL_NO_SESSION_PROVENANCE: Both session FKs are null and an audit snapshot contains this exact payment ID with explicit null session evidence, corroborated by a code path that conditionally persists no session.
classificationDefinitions.C_NO_SESSION_PROVENANCE_INSUFFICIENT: Both session FKs are null and there is no exact evidence that the historical business path intentionally ran without a session. Blocks immediate-payment transform.
classificationDefinitions.D: Dual, missing, or incompatible session references / ownership context.

files.finding: The shared closer accepts optional sessaoCaixaId/sessaoCaixaEventoId and writes the FK only when a caller provides it. This explains how a closed command can persist a payment with null session, but does not prove which session or policy applied to each old row.
Event close and grouped close pass the authorized event cash session to the shared closer.
Standalone event sales pass the event cash session to the shared closer.
Current operational close passes the authorized Por Caixa session.

Before both B receipt timestamps, this route persisted sessaoCaixaId as the open session ID or null; it returned PENDURADO without an open session and logged a SALE_PAYMENT_RECORDED payload containing linked Payment identity and session fields.
Debt receipts attach sessaoCaixaEventoId only when an event cash session is open; otherwise audit metadata explicitly classifies FORA_DO_CAIXA.
Introduces nullable contaReceberId and sessaoCaixaId fields; no data rewrite establishes a historic session.
Introduces nullable sessaoCaixaEventoId and its FK; no backfill establishes a historic session. The FK uses ON DELETE SET NULL, so a present-day null alone cannot prove original state.
Later candidate adds the sessaoCaixaId FK to quiosque.SessaoCaixaQuiosque with ON DELETE RESTRICT; this migration is not in the DEV ledger and performs no historical session backfill.
Session expected totals consume payments loaded through the SessaoCaixaEvento relation, hence require the persisted event-session FK.
Por Caixa close totals query either exact sessaoCaixaId or a legacy null-session, no-receivable fallback by PDV, operation day, closed command time within the session interval.
Turn dashboard uses the same exact-link OR temporal fallback for null-session/no-debt immediate payments.
Command financial summary totals every included command payment regardless of session reference.
Event command report loads each payment from closed commands and groups by payment form without filtering on session reference.

sessionScopedCash.exactLinks: 26 payments / 115400 cents: 2 CIA EVENTO and 24 Churrasquinho (all PIX; 4 linked Churrasquinho rows are attached to CANCELADA commands but have 0 cents).
sessionScopedCash.ciaEventCash: The event cash summary includes only payments related through sessaoCaixaEventoId; it includes the 2 exact links (13600 cents) and omits 430 null-session EVENTO payments (2188900 cents).
sessionScopedCash.churrasquinhoOperationalCash: Current Por Caixa close/dashboard code also has a legacy fallback for sessaoCaixaId null, no receivable, same PDV/day and closed command time inside a session open/close interval. All 147 C payments (1282000 cents) satisfy exactly one such interval in this photo. This is a report-time heuristic; it is not persisted provenance and does not authorize migration linkage.
sessionScopedCash.provenDebtReceipts: The 2 B debt receipts (5200 cents) are excluded from that operational fallback because contaReceberId is set; they remain on their original receivables.

reportImpact.commandFinancialReports: Existing command-level reports include all payments through closed commands regardless of session link; session null does not remove the payment from global command financial totals.
reportImpact.reconciliation: Reconcile all 605 Payment IDs/amounts/dates once; separately reconcile exact session links, the 430 CIA EVENTO no-session rows omitted from event cash, the 147 Churrasquinho rows currently included by interval fallback, and the two debt receipts. Preserve receivable principal/receipts/balance and avoid counting receipt plus original command value twice.

migrationDecisionProposal.restoreOnlyExactLinks: No sessionless payment in this photo has a demonstrated exact historical session reference. Restore a link only from direct persisted evidence (or another immutable exact source reference); none of the candidate dates/values/events/sole-session coincidences qualifies.
migrationDecisionProposal.preserveProvenNoSession: Keep the two proven debt receipts linked to their existing ContaReceber with sessaoCaixaId null. The existing transform supports this case and cash-session totals exclude them. For immediate sales, preserving null session requires explicit business approval and a durable source disposition/provenance marker; do not create sessions.
migrationDecisionProposal.keepBlocked: Keep all 577 immediate payments classified C blocked until exact session evidence or an approved historical no-session policy and representation exist. Any future D references also remain blocked for manual resolution.
reconciliationGates: Source and target payment ID set equal; exact cents, dates, payment form, author, change, command and receivable IDs preserved.
Per-account principal = receipts + balance; each receipt applied once; no duplicate contribution to command sale totals.
Per-session payments reconcile only from explicit links; null-session records remain out of cash-session totals.
Per tenant, payment totals by origin/form/date and receivable linkage reconcile before/after; customer financial history retains original payment IDs/dates.
Do not move cash or create synthetic sessions to force close-count equality.
